images.caption: The Kenneli DIY skatehall in one of the buildings of a former pulp mill in Lielahti, Tampere, Finland. The photo was taken during the annual Manserama skateboarding event and competition. When I shot it, there was a little break in the event that made a lot of the audience go outside the hall for a while. During most of the "action" – in particular, the Open series of the competition – the place was largely packed with folks.
images.alt: The Kenneli DIY skatehall in one of the buildings of a former pulp mill in Lielahti, Tampere, Finland. The photo was taken during the annual Manserama skateboarding event and competition. When I shot it, there was a little break in the event that made a lot of the audience go outside the hall for a while. During most of the "action" – in particular, the Open series of the competition – the place was largely packed with folks.
